description: Lightweight technique registry. Rows do not require Landscape/Shortlist/Ingest/Normalization. Fill: docs/practices/PRACTICE_LIBRARY_FILL_V1.md

techniques.note: Equal-count / four-phase hold research became a sunk-cost trap. Do not continue Safety Review V1.1 or targeted safety work on this type. Use another suitable type for the need. Existing library items stay provisional without technique_id.

techniques.canonical_description: A short unforced breath cycle: inhale gently through the nose, then exhale longer than the inhale, without a hold. Counting (for example two in / three out, or five in / seven out) is only a pace aid. Breath-holds are not part of this product version.

source_refs.source: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS — Breathing pattern disorders and physiotherapy
source_refs.locus: Breathing control exercises, Step 2 Slow breathing (in for one-to-two-or-three, out for one-to-three-or-four; out-breath passive); during activity, out-breath longer than in-breath
source_refs.note: official_health. Method confirmation only. Not imported as a breathlessness-retraining protocol. Optional post-exhale pause in that page is not in this product version.

source_refs.source: Berkshire Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust — How breathing can reduce stress and anxiety
source_refs.locus: Tip 1: rectangular breathing, inhale 5 seconds and exhale 7 seconds, then repeating
source_refs.note: official_health. Longer out-breath, no hold in this example.

safety_notes: Do not force the out-breath or take bigger breaths.
This product version has no breath-hold.
